data.name: Avalon Legends Solitaire 2
data.detailed_description:
Harness the magic of the cards to rebuild Camelot!

The fate of Camelot is in your hands! The Druids of Avalon channel the forces of nature through their magic cards, using them to weave powerful spells of growth and healing. There are rules to their magic, however, and the cards must be placed in the correct order by a careful hand in order to function.

Although reclusive by nature, the druids have a long-standing alliance with King Arthur and his knights of Camelot, having pledged to come to their aid in times of need. Now is such a time! Camelot lies in ruins, sacked by goblins and Arthur needs your help to rebuild it.

Harness the power of the cards as you travel across Avalon through 300 meticulously crafted levels of engaging solitaire to collect the resources you need to restore the kingdom to glory. Simultaneously relaxing and challenging, Avalon Solitaire 2 features 24 power-ups, over 30 buildings to rebuild and reap benefits from, plus wild cards, jokers, hazards and more, making it a must-play for solitaire fans!

  • 300 levels of addictive solitaire!
  • Rebuild Camelot with over 30 buildings
  • Harness the power of 24 unique power-ups!
  • High-res graphics bring Camelot to life
  • Two difficulty modes to suit your style of play

reviews.review:
Developed and published by Anawiki Games, Avalon Legends Solitaire 2 transforms the familiar mechanics of solitaire into a fantasy adventure centered on restoring the legendary kingdom of Camelot. Set after a devastating goblin invasion, the game places players in the role of rebuilding a once-great realm by completing increasingly elaborate solitaire challenges. Rather than relying solely on card-clearing gameplay, it introduces a rewarding progression system that ties every completed level to the reconstruction of villages, castles, and magical landmarks. The Arthurian setting adds a pleasant layer of charm without overshadowing the relaxing nature of the core experience, making it easy to become invested in both the gameplay and the gradual rebirth of Avalon.

The campaign offers an impressive collection of 300 handcrafted levels, providing plenty of content for both casual players and longtime fans of solitaire. Each stage follows the accessible one-card higher or lower rule, but the layouts steadily become more intricate, encouraging players to think several moves ahead instead of simply reacting to whatever card appears next. As the journey unfolds, new mechanics such as wild cards, blockers, special bonuses, and unique obstacles are introduced to keep the gameplay from becoming repetitive. The addition of two difficulty settings also allows newcomers to enjoy a forgiving experience while giving experienced players the opportunity to tackle more demanding puzzles that require careful planning and efficient use of every card.

What distinguishes Avalon Legends Solitaire 2 from many other solitaire titles is its kingdom-building progression. Completing levels rewards valuable resources that can be invested in restoring over thirty different structures throughout Camelot. Each completed building contributes useful bonuses that improve future gameplay, creating a satisfying cycle where every puzzle solved feels meaningful. Alongside this system are twenty-four unlockable power-ups that can help overcome particularly challenging stages without completely removing the need for strategy. The steady accumulation of upgrades gives players a constant sense of advancement and makes the lengthy campaign feel rewarding from beginning to end.

The presentation complements the gameplay well with vibrant fantasy-inspired artwork and an inviting visual style. The environments are colorful, the card designs remain easy to read, and the user interface is clean enough that players can focus entirely on planning their next move. The soundtrack features gentle orchestral melodies that reinforce the game's relaxing atmosphere, while subtle sound effects provide satisfying feedback without becoming distracting during extended play sessions. Technical performance is equally dependable, with smooth gameplay and low system requirements that allow it to run comfortably on a broad range of hardware.

Although the game succeeds in delivering a polished solitaire adventure, a few shortcomings become noticeable during longer sessions. Because the overall structure remains faithful to traditional solitaire, some players may eventually find the repetition unavoidable despite the steady introduction of new mechanics. The progression system is engaging, but there are moments when favorable card draws have a greater impact on success than strategic decision-making. Fortunately, the available power-ups and kingdom upgrades help soften these occasional frustrations, ensuring that difficult stages rarely become discouraging roadblocks.

Avalon Legends Solitaire 2 is an excellent example of how a classic card game can be expanded into a more engaging adventure without sacrificing its relaxing appeal. Its combination of hundreds of thoughtfully designed levels, meaningful progression, fantasy storytelling, and satisfying kingdom restoration creates an experience that offers far more depth than a standard solitaire collection. While it may not convert players who dislike the genre, fans of solitaire and casual strategy games will find plenty to enjoy in its generous amount of content, polished presentation, and rewarding gameplay loop.

Rating: 7/10
